# frontier-commerce

Reusable commerce/payment layer for the EVE Frontier ecosystem on Sui.
Infrastructure library (Move + TS SDK + gas station + indexer); no frontend.

## Rules (authority order)

1. .github/copilot-instructions.md — canonical repo-wide rules (wins on conflict)
2. .github/instructions/move.instructions.md — scoped: **/*.move
3. .github/instructions/typescript.instructions.md — scoped: **/*.ts
4. AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md — shortened mirrors/pointers only

## Facts (source-of-truth order)

1. Code, tests, runtime/on-chain evidence
2. docs/decision-log.md + docs/{architecture,security-model,key-management,integration-guide,distribution}.md
3. README.md (summary)
4. Model memory (lowest; verify Sui APIs at docs.sui.io / installed @mysten/sui)

## Map

- move/frontier_commerce/ — Move package (registry, merchant, catalog, payments,
  entitlements, credits, treasury, events, types, vault) + tests/
- move/mock_eve/ — testnet-only mock currency (never mainnet)
- packages/sdk/ — pure client: config, PTB builders, queries, event parsing
- packages/gas-station/ — sponsorship service (only key-holding component)
- packages/indexer/ — event poller -> SQLite ledger -> reports (cache, not authority)
- examples/demo-consumer/ — localnet E2E proof + testnet deploy/smoke tooling (mutating!)
- deployments/ — descriptor template + README; deployments generate their own descriptor
- observability/ — optional Grafana operator dashboard + collector guidance
- docs/distribution.md + CHANGELOG.md — versioning/release model: git tag vX.Y.Z
  = SDK npm version (one train); @frontier-commerce/sdk on npm; Move source via
  release tags; MVR deliberately NOT used for distribution

## Consumption (external apps)

npm install @frontier-commerce/sdk (pin exact version); deploy YOUR OWN Move
instance from the matching release tag; your deployments/<network>.json is
runtime truth. No shared deployment exists to join.

## Hard limits

No mainnet deploys. No testnet publish/smoke as a side effect. No secrets in
git. No destructive git cleanup. deployments/<network>.json over hard-coded IDs.
No MVR registration; npm publish only via .github/workflows/release.yml.
